process_steps.input_state: commercial Al, Cr, Fe, Ni, and V pellets with purities of 99.5 wt%

evidence.quote: In this work, bulk Al0.5CrFeNiV0.5 HEA specimens were fabricated through the traditional arc-melting method, utilizing the commercial Al, Cr, Fe, Ni, and V pellets with their purities of 99.5 % (weight percent) as initial material. The melting process was conducted in an argon gas protecting atmosphere [33]. Each ingot had a total weight of approximately 70 g and was repetitively melted at least five times to confirm chemical homogeneity.

Fig. 1 (a) presents the XRD analysis of the as-cast Al0.5CrFeNiV0.5 HEA, showing three distinct diffraction peaks corresponding to the (110), (200) and (211) crystal planes of BCC phase.

Moreover, a small amount of fine V-rich strip-like phase is visible. Its volume fraction is estimated to be around 4.3 % based on microstructural observations with a help of ImageJ software. SEM/EDS chemical composition point analysis indicates that the content of V element in the V-rich phase is about 83.79 at% while the concentration of V element in the matrix is about 10.51 at%.
